title: Design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of furan-bearing pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridines as novel inhibitors of CDK2 and P53-MDM2 protein-protein interaction.
authors: Ezzat, Manal Abdel Fattah; Elmasry, Ghada F; El-Mageed, Menna M A Abd; Fouad, Marwa A; Abdel-Aziz, Hatem A; Elewa, Safaa I
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成呋喃吡唑并吡啶类CDK2及P53-MDM2蛋白-蛋白互作抑制剂，虽含分子对接但核心为小分子药物设计与细胞实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The novel series of furan-bearing pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridines were designed as cyclin-dependent kinase 2 (CDK2) inhibitors and as p53-murine double minute 2 (MDM2) inhibitors. The newly synthesized compounds were screened for their antiproliferative activity toward hepatocellular carcinoma (HepG2) and breast cancer (MCF7) cell lines. The most active compounds on both cell lines were additionally evaluated for their in vitro CDK2 inhibitory activity. Compounds 7b and 12f displayed enhanced activity (half-maximal inhibitory concentration [IC(50) ] = 0.46 and 0.27 microM, respectively) in comparison to the standard roscovitine (IC(50)  = 1.41 +/- 0.03 microM), in addition to, cell cycle arrest at S phase and G1/S transition phase in MCF7 cells treated with both compounds, respectively. Moreover, the most active spiro-oxindole derivative against MCF7 cell line, 16a, exhibited enhanced inhibitory activity against p53-MDM2 interaction in vitro (IC(50)  = 3.09 +/- 0.12 microM) compared to nutlin, and increased the levels of both p53 and p21 by nearly fourfold in comparison to the negative control. Molecular docking studies demonstrated the plausible interaction patterns of the most potent derivatives 17b and 12f in the CDK2 binding pocket and the spiro-oxindole 16a with p53-MDM2 complex, respectively. Consequently, the new chemotypes 7b, 12f, and 16a can be presented as promising antitumor hits for further studies and optimization.
abstract_zh: 新型含呋喃的吡唑并[3,4-b]吡啶系列化合物被设计为细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶2（CDK2）抑制剂和p53-鼠双微体2（MDM2）抑制剂。新合成的化合物针对肝细胞癌（HepG2）和乳腺癌（MCF7）细胞系进行了抗增殖活性筛选。对两种细胞系中活性最强的化合物进一步评估了其体外CDK2抑制活性。化合物7b和12f显示出增强的活性（半数抑制浓度[IC(50)]分别为0.46和0.27微摩尔），与标准品roscovitine（IC(50) = 1.41 ± 0.03微摩尔）相比，此外，在分别用这两种化合物处理的MCF7细胞中，分别诱导细胞周期阻滞于S期和G1/S转换期。此外，针对MCF7细胞系活性最强的螺环吲哚衍生物16a，在体外对p53-MDM2相互作用的抑制活性（IC(50) = 3.09 ± 0.12微摩尔）较nutlin有所增强，并且与阴性对照相比，p53和p21的水平均增加了近四倍。分子对接研究展示了最有效衍生物17b和12f在CDK2结合口袋中的合理相互作用模式，以及螺环吲哚16a与p53-MDM2复合物的相互作用模式。因此，新化学型7b、12f和16a可作为有前景的抗肿瘤先导化合物，用于进一步研究和优化。
